notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.description: There is nothing at this address: the page was removed or moved, or the link is wrong. Try the search or go to one of the sections.

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.description: Check the spelling, try other words or reset the filters.

unavailable.title: Material unavailable
unavailable.description: The material has been unpublished, is not published yet, or the archive's server is temporarily not responding. Try opening the page later.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have permission to view this material. Access to restricted materials is limited.

error.title: The page could not be shown
error.description: An error occurred on the site. Try again; if that does not help, use the search or the sections below.

help.searchHint: The search covers the open materials of the site.
